games.name: Fabric Racing Game
games.description: 🏎️ HTML5 single-player championship: race 10 Fabric-themed tracks, stream telemetry via Custom Endpoint + JSON mapping to Eventhouse, analyze in a live KQL dashboard.

games.name: Calc Groups Cathedral
games.description: 🏛️ Replace 12 redundant time-intelligence measures with one elegant Calculation Group on a real Direct Lake semantic model. Earn the rank of Cathedral Builder.

games.name: City Builder — Datapolis
games.description: 🏙️ Become Mayor of a floating retro-cyberpunk city and rebuild its municipal Data Warehouse district by district. 8 districts of dimensional modeling in T-SQL + DAX, validated live.

games.name: Ontology Detective - Datapolis P.I.
games.description: 🕵️ You are Detective Sherlock Graph at Datapolis P.I. Design a real Fabric Ontology in Digital Twin Builder, query evidence in KQL, catch the culprit. 5 noir cases.

games.name: Monster Breach - Pipeline Defense
games.description: 🧙‍♂️ Build real Fabric Data Pipelines to defeat the Corruption Horde. Four monsters each guard two data defects; clean the crystals, then face the Corruption King in a mega-pipeline that combines every technique.

games.name: Oracle's Forge
games.description: 🔮 Forge Prophecy Crystals (ML models) in the Sacred Fire. Train models with AutoML, track experiments in MLflow, crown a champion and predict the future with batch scoring.

games.name: Sentinel Grid
games.description: 🛰️ Guard the Sentinel Grid of Datapolis. Build Activator rules on live event streams and neutralize five incidents by wiring the right condition to the right action.

games.name: Purity Protocol
games.description: ⚗️ Distill raw ingredients into pure essences using the power of Power Query M. Five Dataflow Gen2 levels of cleaning, merging and reshaping, output to Lakehouse.

games.name: Portal Nexus
games.description: 🌀 Keep the Nexus of Portals. Link external worlds with Mirroring and OneLake Shortcuts without copying them, then query the multiverse in natural language with a Data Agent.

games.name: Vault Keeper
games.description: 🏦 Guard the transactional Vault of Datapolis on a Fabric SQL Database. Design tables, write stored procedures and run ACID transactions to keep the city's ledger honest.

games.name: The Sphinx
games.description: 🦁 Awaken the Sphinx of Datapolis: build a Fabric Data Agent over your data and teach it to answer riddles in natural language. Ground it, test it, and pass the Trial of Questions.
